description: Keeps Tableau's licensing and user services from quietly breaking. Migrated ATR to Hyperforce — Bazel, Vault, KMS, the whole stack before it became mandatory.
Shipped 5 APIs for cashback and transactions that held up under real traffic. Ktor and Dagger, 6 months, zero P0s.
Turned a manual regression suite into a Selenium + Pytest framework. Saved someone's Monday mornings indefinitely.
